meta.name: autoresearch
meta.description: Autonomous iterative experimentation loop for any programming task. Guides the user through defining goals, measurable metrics, and scope constraints, then runs an autonomous loop of code changes, testing, measuring, and keeping/discarding results. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch. USE FOR: autonomous improvement, iterative optimization, experiment loop, auto research, performance tuning, automated experimentation, hill climbing, try things automatically, optimize code, run experiments, autonomous coding loop. DO NOT USE FOR: one-shot tasks, simple bug fixes, code review, or tasks without a measurable metric.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动运行实验循环，迭代优化代码性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望让代码自动尝试多种改进方案并保留最佳结果
copy.tagline_en: Run autonomous experiment loops to iteratively optimize code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want code to automatically try multiple improvements and keep the best results

howto.what: Claude 会引导你设定实验目标、衡量指标和范围，然后自动循环修改代码、运行测试、测量结果，保留改进、丢弃无效改动，直到你中断或达到实验次数。
howto.when: 当你需要自动化迭代优化代码性能、运行多轮实验时，比如优化执行时间、内存使用或测试通过率。

say.text: 帮我自动优化这个Python脚本的执行时间。
say.note: Claude 会先询问具体指标，然后启动实验循环。

say.text: 请你设计一个实验循环，改进数据库查询性能。
say.note: 需要设定指标命令和范围，Claude 会自主迭代。

say.text: 启动自主实验，优化图像处理速度。
say.note: 确保已安装git，Claude 会在新分支上运行实验。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to define goals, measurable metrics, and scope, then autonomously loops: editing code, running tests, measuring results, keeping improvements, and discarding failures until you stop or budget ends.
howto.when_en: When you need automated iterative optimization for code, e.g., reducing execution time, memory usage, or improving test pass rates through repeated experiments.

say_en.text: Help me auto-optimize the execution time of this Python script.
say_en.note: Claude asks for metric command then starts the loop.

say_en.text: Design an experiment loop to improve database query performance.
say_en.note: Specify metric command and scope; Claude iterates autonomously.

say_en.text: Launch an autonomous experiment to optimize image processing speed.
say_en.note: Requires git; Claude runs experiments on a new branch.
